d: Anton Oilfield Services Group is a globally leading independent integrated oilfield technology services company, operating across major oil and gas production regions worldwide. The business covers oilfield technical services, oilfield management services, oil and gas development operations, natural gas utilization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform collaboration. Anton Group employs approximately 7,000 staff from over 30 countries and regions. Anton’s long-term goal is to become a world-leading green energy technical services company, growing together with its clients and talent to promote high-quality development in the energy industry.
q: li
Diploma in Chemical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Process Engineering, or Process Control Technology. A relevant Science degree is also acceptable.
li
Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas or industrial process plant operations.
li
Practical experience operating production facilities and process equipment, preferably involving crude treatment, dehydration, desalting, gas processing, and water injection systems.
li
Knowledge of plant commissioning, shutdown, routine inspections, chemical handling, sampling, and process monitoring.
li
Understanding of work permit systems, process safety, and HSE requirements.
li
Ability to interpret operating parameters, maintain production records, and identify abnormal plant conditions.
li
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
li
Willingness to work on a rotational shift basis.
r: li
Operate and monitor production facilities and process units on a shift basis, including commissioning and decommissioning activities.
li
Conduct routine plant inspections to ensure safe and efficient operation of process equipment, machinery, pumps, and auxiliary systems.
li
Operate and adjust valves, pumps, machinery, and process equipment in accordance with operating procedures and HSE requirements.
li
Monitor and control crude oil treatment, dehydration, desalting, gas sweetening, gas dehydration, water injection, and other process systems.
li
Monitor chemical consumption and injection rates, maintain optimum chemical dosage, and report abnormal consumption or operating conditions.
li
Perform pre-start-up, shutdown, commissioning, and decommissioning activities and adjust operating parameters to maintain process efficiency.
li
Monitor water levels, flow rates, tank inventories, and other process parameters to ensure continuous facility operation.
li
Collect process samples, coordinate laboratory testing, and communicate results to the relevant operations personnel.
li
Perform routine equipment care, including lubrication, oil replenishment, chemical addition, valve operation, separator draining, and process adjustments.
li
Record and report operational data, including production volumes, gas and water flow rates, crude quality, chemical consumption, and equipment performance.
li
Conduct process safety checks, support work permit activities, and ensure compliance with HSE procedures and emergency response requirements.
li
Inspect fire protection systems, operate fire pumps and standby generators, and report equipment deficiencies.
li
Identify and report abnormal operating conditions and take appropriate emergency action to protect personnel, equipment, and facilities.
li
Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping across assigned plant areas and equipment.
li
Perform shift duties and other operational tasks as assigned.

d: We are looking for an experienced Front-End UI Developer with strong expertise in React, TypeScript, and SharePoint Online (SPO) custom UI development. The successful candidate will be responsible for translating Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive, and modular React components for modern SharePoint Online interfaces.

The role involves working closely with backend developers to integrate custom UI components into the SharePoint Framework (SPFx), while accommodating iterative design updates throughout the development process.
Figma-to-React Development: Translate Figma designs into clean, production-ready React functional components using TypeScript, ensuring flexibility to accommodate visual adjustments.

Modular and Scoped Styling: Develop clean, maintainable SCSS using CSS Modules ([ComponentName].module.scss) to ensure styles remain isolated and do not conflict with SharePoint Online's global styling.
Modern UI Development: Implement Microsoft Fluent UI React components to deliver consistent and seamless user interfaces.

Responsive Web Design: Develop mobile-first, responsive layouts using Flexbox and CSS Grid, ensuring compatibility across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices, including Safari, Chrome, and the native SharePoint Mobile App.

SharePoint Integration: Collaborate with backend developers to define TypeScript component props and data-binding structures, enabling seamless integration of SharePoint list data into custom UI components.
q: li
Minimum 3+ years of professional experience in React (v17/v18) and TypeScript.
li
Mandatory experience in custom UI development for SharePoint or SharePoint Online (SPO) projects.
li
Strong knowledge of HTML5, SCSS, CSS Grid, Flexbox, and CSS Modules.
li
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fluent UI React framework (v8/v9).
li
Strong understanding of responsive web design principles and mobile-first development.
li
Familiarity with touch-target sizing and mobile WebView constraints within the native SharePoint Mobile App.
li
Ability to translate design concepts into pixel-perfect, functional, and maintainable UI components.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a senior design manager to play a key role making open source software available to the world. Our Design function ensures the experience of the software and infrastructure we build is true to our intentions, and delivers the tools our community and customers need. The Design Manager makes this possible through leadership within, and beyond, our teams.

As a Senior Design Manager, you bring both experience managing design teams and have expertise in a deeply technical domain. This enables you to coach designers in creating tools for developers and cloud engineers, and cross-context to move towards tangible outcomes and lift the quality of their work. You will manage expectations and ensure deadlines are met in a timely manner against your roadmap. You will be able to communicate clearly and actively listen to product and engineering stakeholders, and your team, to drive sustainable quality improvements and guide individuals towards meaningful growth.

Leading the Infrastructure Design team, you will take responsibility for the products that help to build cloud experiences and software distribution mechanisms, and you will help to evolve the security of how software is packaged and delivered.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
Reviewing the work of your design team for quality
Working with individual designers to support their professional growth
Continuously improving operational workflows, including production outsourcing and collaboration with Web Engineering
Working with stakeholders, especially the Engineering organization, to clearly define and validate outcomes
Evolving design systems and guidelines to drive consistent quality and improve efficiency
Coordinating with the rest of design leadership to mature our collective practice
Bringing your team and others together to share their work and strengthen culture
Engaging the open source community to learn and make the value of our work legible
What we are looking for in you
A portfolio demonstrating outstanding quality in UX design and savviness in technology
Exceptional educational achievements in design or related behavioral science discipline
Full lifecycle experience from user needs discovery through validation and implementation guidance
Commitment to transparent project delivery and owning team deadlines
Experience of managing a team that interacts with technical stakeholders
A passion for balancing consistency and innovation
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
Spatial Works is a Kuwait-based interior design and fit-out studio specializing in residential, commercial, and cultural projects, from initial design concepts to final project handover.
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Site Supervisor to join our team and take full responsibility for managing and supervising project execution.

The ideal candidate should combine strong technical expertise with leadership, planning, cost control, and the ability to manage labour and subcontractors while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to the required quality standards.
Supervise all phases of interior design, fit-out, and finishing works.
Ensure that executed works comply with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and personally verify actual site measurements and conditions.
Prepare, review, and verify Bills of Quantities (BOQ) against drawings and actual site measurements.
Validate material quantities and project requirements before execution.
Monitor material consumption and project costs to achieve operational efficiency and cost savings.
Develop detailed weekly execution programmes for each project.
Determine workforce requirements, crew sizes, and subcontractor execution durations.
Prepare execution plans before client contracts are signed.
Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion and handover.
Source, recruit, and manage skilled labour and subcontractors.
Obtain a minimum of three quotations for required works and services.
Manage subcontractor agreements, attendance, productivity, and performance.
Ensure that all relevant documentation and permits are valid and up to date.
Monitor workmanship and quality throughout all project stages.
Ensure materials and samples are approved before implementation.
Apply inspection checkpoints and quality control checklists.
Resolve technical issues and close all outstanding snag items before final handover.
Prepare daily and weekly progress reports.
Monitor workforce performance, subcontractor productivity, and project progress.
Maintain and regularly update project dashboards.
🎓 Minimum 5 years of relevant experience supervising interior design, fit-out, and finishing projects in Kuwait.
🔹 Established professional network of skilled labour, technicians, and reliable subcontractors.
🔹 Strong experience in BOQ preparation, quantity surveying, and site measurements.
🔹 Ability to read, interpret, and analyse technical and architectural drawings using AutoCAD.
🔹 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project scheduling and monitoring tools.
🔹 Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
🔹 Good command of both Arabic and English.
🚗 Valid Kuwaiti driving licence and own vehicle.
🪪 Transferable residency in Kuwait for non-Kuwaiti applicants.
💰 Competitive monthly salary based on experience and professional qualifications.
🏆 Performance-based savings bonus for projects delivered within approved budgets and agreed timelines.
🤝 Professional working environment with clearly defined responsibilities and authority.
📈 Opportunity to work with a specialised, design-led team focused on quality and execution excellence.
📩 Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to submit:
📸 Photos and a portfolio of recently completed projects they have personally supervised.
📝 A brief summary of their project experience, responsibilities, and achievements.

Software Engineers & Code Owners – AI Code Licensing Program

Gramian is participating in an exclusive, invite-only code licensing program with a leading AI lab. The program allows software developers, engineers, and organizations to earn compensation by licensing existing software repositories for AI training and research purposes.
This is a non-exclusive licensing opportunity, meaning code owners retain their intellectual property and can continue using, maintaining, selling, or licensing their software elsewhere.
We are looking for high-quality, complete software projects, particularly in:
Legacy Systems (Highest Priority): COBOL, Fortran, JCL — ideally 10,000+ lines of production code from banking, insurance, or scientific systems. Retired systems are welcome.
Modern Development: Kotlin, OCaml, TypeScript, React, Next.js.
Game Development: Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, Godot 4, Unity C#, Unreal C++, Phaser 3.
Valuation: $100/M of tokens of code and $40/M tokens of Git history (offline script available so you can run evaluations without entering the program)
No new development required — license your existing code.
Payments expected: Before Christmas 2026, or by January 21, 2027, if QA is delayed.
Future cohorts: Potential additional opportunities starting January 2027.
q: li
Private codebases only: Code must never have been publicly available, including on GitHub, GitLab, npm, or PyPI.
li
Human-written code: AI-generated code is not accepted. Projects developed before 2025 are preferred; newer projects require additional verification.
li
Code ownership: Applicants must own the code or have full licensing rights. Client-owned projects require written authorization.
li
Substantial, functional projects: Complete applications, SaaS platforms, backends, internal tools, or production systems. No basic templates, forks, WordPress projects, or code snippets.
li
Git history: Repositories should include original commit history, ideally with multiple contributors, pull requests, code reviews, issues, and tests.
li
Repository access: Code should be accessible directly through GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket for evaluation.
li
Bonus: Supporting project documentation, tickets, and development records may provide additional licensing opportunities.
